lines.t: I saw you weep alone,
when none could see but Me.
I saw you choose the narrow road,
though wide ones offered free.
I saw you give your coins away
to feed the one who could not pay.
You called it small - but Heaven sang;
My hands were yours that day.
I saw it, I saw it -
every glance that turned toward light.
I saw it, I saw it.
every time you fought the night.
I saw the love the world forgot,
I saw the flame that would not die.
My beloved, I saw of Myself in you.
I saw you bear their scorn,
and keep your peace instead.
I saw you wake to read My Word,
living not alone by bread.
I saw the day you sold your things
and placed them in a beggar's hand.
You thought it gone - but I was near,
and kept it in My plan.
I saw it, I saw it -
every seed you sowed unseen.
I saw it, I saw it.
your quiet faith between.
Though weak you feel, though small it seemed,
I saw your love, your steady dream.
My beloved, I saw of Myself in you..
I saw you give Me every part - your pride, your fear, your name.
I saw you trust when others judged, and stood through every blame.
I saw the day you laid them down—your comfort and your crown.
You thought you fell - but I reached through, and brought your heart back round.
I saw it, I saw it -
your gaze that broke My heart with love.
I saw it, I saw it
the way you looked to Me above.
Each tear, each trembling, whispered prayer,
each loss you bore in lonely care -
My beloved, I saw of Myself in you. .
My Bride, the time has come -
And my heart is moved.
your lamp still burns, your race is won.
You are with Me where I am…
I saw it all.
I am pleased
